title: Orchestre Sinza Kotoko - Wikipedia
text: Orchestre Sinza Kotoko was a pioneering Congolese soukous band founded in 1964 by guitarist Jacques Kimbembe "Mouss" in Brazzaville. Initially named as Super Band or Super Tumba, the band adopted the name Orchestre Sinza Kotoko in 1965.
